headline: It starts with one finger. It never really lets go.
body:
You're one day old, fist on my finger.
I hold on.

You're five, at the edge of a busy road.
I hold on, and I don't let go first.

You're fourteen and won't hold hands.
I hold on from across the parking lot.

You're thirty, with a baby of your own.
I hold your other hand.

*The grip changes every few years.*
*The hold never does.*
